hypothesis: Negative annual broker-dealer book-leverage growth, measured point-in-time from the same original Federal Reserve Z.1 release, identifies frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early and can improve return while matching or exceeding V11 Sharpe and beating an availability-matched unconditional U.S.-retention control.
allowed_changes: F-BDLEV-ANNUAL-US exact book leverage = Total Financial Assets / (Total Financial Assets - Total Liabilities)
annual growth = log current-quarter book leverage minus log four-quarter-lag book leverage, with both balance sheets read from the same historical first-release Z.1 table
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events, retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when favorable
selection_metric: No within-family model selection. Compare the single candidate against frozen V11 and C-BDLEV-ALWAYS, then apply every preregistered deterministic, bootstrap and cumulative DSR gate.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260821
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate and no within-family selection
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using prior 27 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-BDLEV-ANNUAL-US, total trial count 28
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This broker-dealer leverage campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not search quarterly leverage changes, leverage levels, positive-growth sign reversals, capital-ratio inversions, seasonal adjustments, winsorization, clipping, alternate growth horizons, thresholds, persistence rules, retention fractions, release lags, stale windows, Nasdaq confirmation, ensembles, or a second retrospective broker-dealer leverage family. A promising non-robust result may only become a separately preregistered prospective shadow from a new freeze date.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_broker_dealer_leverage_v1.py -> tools/broker_dealer_leverage_v1.swiftpart + tools/broker_dealer_leverage_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/U.S.-de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: Federal Reserve historical Financial Accounts of the United States Z.1 release archive
factor_definition.book_leverage_rule: Total Financial Assets / (Total Financial Assets - Total Liabilities)
factor_definition.annual_growth_rule: log(current book leverage) - log(four-quarter-lag book leverage), both calculated from values in the same historical release table
factor_definition.quarterly_change: diagnostic only; forbidden as a return-seeking candidate
factor_definition.availability_rule: historical official Z.1 release date + 1 calendar day

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of annual broker-dealer leverage growth

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current frozen V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus prior frozen V11 event target

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
using today's revised FRED/Z.1 history instead of frozen first-release tables
using cross-release quarter-over-quarter differences that mix statistical vintages
using quarterly leverage change as a return-seeking candidate
using leverage levels, capital ratios, inverse leverage or positive-growth sign reversal
any seasonal adjustment, winsorization, clipping, z-score, percentile, level or magnitude threshold
any 2-quarter, 3-quarter, 2-year or other alternate growth horizon
any change to release+1 availability or 150-day stale guard
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective broker-dealer leverage factor after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting
